newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: McCarthy Retail to list on the BSE Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: McCarthy Retail to list on the BSE Tuesday.

text.p: South African retailer McCarthy Retail will dual list on the Botswana Stock Exchange (BSE) on Tuesday.
The dual listing, the third on the BSE this year, is expected to add 1.85 billion pula or four percent to the exchange's market capitalisation.
McCarthy will list some 160.05 million shares on the exchange, bringing the BSE's total market capitalisation to 52.3 billion pula.
McCarthy Retail shares were last trading at 14.50 rand on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.
The group's total investment in Botswana is 60 million pula.

In November 1996, the group bought control of the Botswana Land Rover dealership, BM Engineering (BME) for 10 million pula cash, adding it to a 50 million pula investment in retail stores Game, Beares, Savells, Bee Gee, Prefsure, Guys 'n Girls, Happy Homes and Bonus Building Supplies.
The group's investments in Botswana are its largest outside South Africa.
